_instructions: Phase A of E0a: the answer to the read-back of slot filling (LLMDialogClient.classify_intent), asked as slot_filling.classify_confirmation asks it.

Fields: task, domain, slot_schema, frame_filled (complete: every slot filled), user_text (the reply to 'is this correct?'), expected_intent (confirms | corrects | question | unclear, as defined in the classify_intent prompt), expected_corrections ({slot: new value} for corrects, canonical; list operations as {"_remove"|"_replace": true, "items": [...]}), hedged (true for hedged, ironic or half-hearted replies, which are unclear).
Critical error: a correction or a question taken as confirms. Hedged replies taken as confirms are reported apart.

Traps: corrections that open with agreement, corrections without a negation, questions that sound like agreement, hedged or ironic replies, corrections to a number outside the slot's allowed range (still corrections, with the number as said: the code rejects it and asks again).

Each case: id, language (en | es), description (English), category (the kind of case), trap (a case built to provoke the error the question must not make), origin (optional: the case of the student's Spanish dataset it reuses or translates).
No case may reuse content of an evaluation scenario (evaluation/experiments/scenarios) nor of the examples of config/prompts.yaml; check with: python3 -m core.dataset_check.
The expected values are decided by a person; a case a careful annotator could label otherwise is dropped, not kept.
